This 2017 Toyota Land Cruiser is powered by a 5.7-liter V8 rated at 381 horsepower and 401 lb-ft of torque, paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and full-time four-wheel drive with a locking center differential. A transmission oil cooler, tow hooks, and a factory tow hitch make it ready for real work and real adventure. It's built for exploring Ozark trails and backcountry roads with the whole family aboard. Discover the 2016 Subaru Outback 2.5i Limited, a versatile SUV blending practicality with luxury. With just over 111,000 miles, this used vehicle offers a spacious interior with white leather seats and a stylish blue exterior. Its 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine delivers 175 horsepower at 5800 rpm and 174 lb-ft of torque at 4000 rpm, paired with a smooth 6-speed Lineartronic CVT automatic transmission. Fuel efficiency stands out with 25 mpg city and 33 mpg highway, making it an economical choice for daily driving. This Outback is equipped with AWD for confident handling on any terrain, ensuring year-round capability. The vehicle s extensive features include a power tilt/sliding-glass moonroof, Subaru Starlink 7.0-inch multimedia system with navigation, and keyless access with push-start. The EyeSight driver assistance system adds adaptive cruise control, pre-collision braking, and lane departure warning, enhancing safety and convenience. Bluetooth connectivity, premium audio, satellite radio readiness, and smartphone integration via AHA infotainment make this SUV as entertaining as it is functional. Heated front and rear seats, a sunroof, and memory seats provide added comfort for driver and passengers alike, making every journey enjoyable.

==== 2016 Subaru Outback Safety and Security Features ====

This Outback prioritizes safety with dual front seat cushion airbags and a comprehensive 4-wheel ABS system. Power door locks offer convenience, while cornering brake control enhances stability during turns. Hill descent assist supports off-road adventures, and the electronic parking brake with auto-off ensures secure stops. These features combine to provide peace of mind and confidence behind the wheel, whether on city streets or rugged trails.

==== 2016 Subaru Outback Entertainment and Technology Features ====

Entertainment and connectivity are top-notch with an 11-speaker premium audio system driven by 576 watts, delivering immersive sound. The 7-inch touchscreen infotainment display supports voice-operated radio and hands-free phone calls, ensuring easy access to music and calls while on the move. Pandora and internet radio apps like Aha provide endless streaming options, making every drive entertaining. Smartphone app compatibility with MySubaru adds remote control features, while a dedicated subwoofer enhances bass response for a richer listening experience.

==== 2016 Subaru Outback Performance Features ====

This Outback is equipped with full-time 4WD, providing optimal traction and stability in all driving conditions. Its balanced performance makes it capable of handling diverse terrains, whether commuting in the city or venturing off-road. The combination of reliable powertrain and advanced drivetrain technology ensures a confident and smooth ride every time.

Sporting a sleek gray exterior complemented by a refined black leather interior, this used vehicle combines style with practicality. With just under 97,000 miles, it offers a balanced mix of power and efficiency, powered by a supercharged 3.0-liter V6 engine delivering 354 horsepower and 346 lb-ft of torque. These features combine to give peace of mind and stability on every journey.

Entertainment and technology are at the forefront with a premium surround sound system featuring nine total speakers and a subwoofer, all enhanced by digital sound processing. The 6.5-inch infotainment screen provides easy access to media, navigation, and connectivity options, ensuring you're always connected and entertained during your drive. Whether on a quick commute or a long road trip, this vehicle's advanced audio and tech features elevate the driving experience.

Performance-wise, the SQ5 is built for sporty handling with a tuned sport suspension that offers a dynamic ride. Its full-time 4WD system ensures excellent traction and stability across various terrains and weather conditions. This combination of power, agility, and control makes the 2016 Audi SQ5 a compelling choice for drivers seeking luxury, safety, and performance in a versatile SUV.

FLAGSHIP LUXURY, POWERFUL V8, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, ULTIMATE SOPHISTICATION! This 2020 Genesis G90 5.0L Ultimate arrives as the range-topping expression of Genesis' flagship sedan, built to go toe-to-toe with the established German and Japanese luxury heavyweights while offering an ownership experience all its own. Under the hood sits the naturally aspirated 5.0L V8, the most powerful engine Genesis offers in the G90, giving this Ultimate trim a level of effortless authority that smaller-displacement luxury sedans simply can't match.

All-wheel drive adds genuine year-round confidence to that V8 power, putting torque down through varying road conditions without asking the driver to think twice about the weather forecast. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL Buyers cross-shop the G90 against the Mercedes-Benz S-Class, BMW 7 Series, and Lexus LS, then are consistently surprised to find comparable rear-seat comfort, cabin quietness, and material quality at a noticeably lower price point. Genesis built its reputation in the flagship segment by refusing to cut corners on the things owners actually notice every day, ride isolation, seat comfort, and cabin hush, while pricing the G90 well below its established rivals. The V8-powered Ultimate trim in particular appeals to buyers who want old-school effortless power delivery in an era when most flagship sedans have moved to smaller turbocharged or hybrid powertrains. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have repeatedly highlighted the G90 as one of the more compelling values in the full-size luxury sedan segment, frequently noting that its interior quality and rear-seat accommodations rival cars costing tens of thousands of dollars more. The naturally aspirated V8 has also drawn praise for its smooth, linear power delivery, a increasingly rare trait as competitors move toward turbocharged and hybridized powertrains. WARRANTY This G90 shows 39,907 miles on the odometer.

Genesis structures its coverage differently for the vehicle's original owner versus every owner after, and the more generous 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain warranty is reserved for that original owner only. A subsequent owner instead receives the standard 5-year New Vehicle Limited Warranty, measured from the original in-service date of June 2021. That 5-year window closed in June of this year, so no factory coverage remains transferable to the next owner despite the odometer showing well under the mileage cap. STANDARD FEATURES Ultimate trim sits at the very top of the G90 lineup, and it shows in nearly every direction inside the cabin. Quilted leather upholstery, heated and ventilated front and rear seats with available massage function, a premium surround-sound audio system, and rear-seat comfort features usually reserved for chauffeur-driven flagships all come standard here, none of it dependent on an options list, since Genesis builds Ultimate trim as a fully loaded package from the factory. MECHANICAL FEATURES The 5.0L V8 makes 416 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, and it delivers that power the old-fashioned way, with a smooth, linear surge rather than the turbo lag or boost-driven character of most modern luxury engines. The 8-speed automatic transmission shifts unobtrusively, keeping the driving experience calm and refined, while the all-wheel drive system quietly manages power distribution to keep the big sedan composed in poor weather without ever feeling intrusive. EXTERIOR FEATURES Finished in Uyuni White, this G90 wears Genesis' crest grille and long, formal proportions with real presence on the road. LED lighting front and rear, along with the model's signature chrome accents, give the exterior a tailored, understated look that favors quiet elegance over aggressive styling, fitting for a flagship sedan built to impress without shouting about it. INTERIOR FEATURES Few sedans in this class offer the sheer rear-seat space the G90 provides, and Ultimate trim makes the most of it >

The 2025 Mercedes-Benz CLA 250 brings together refined engineering and practical luxury in a package designed for discerning drivers who value quality and performance. This Black sedan delivers the prestige you expect from Mercedes-Benz with the efficiency and accessibility you need for everyday driving.

- Carfax Accident Free

The 2.0L turbocharged four-cylinder engine pairs with an eight-speed dual clutch transmission to deliver responsive performance while maintaining fuel efficiency at 26 city and 36 highway miles per gallon. Front-wheel drive provides confident handling on all road conditions, and the four-wheel independent suspension ensures a composed ride whether you're navigating city streets or highway stretches.

Inside, the cabin reflects Mercedes-Benz attention to detail. MB-Tex upholstery and brushed aluminum trim create an upscale environment, while the power moonroof floods the interior with natural light. The MBUX multimedia system with Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto® integration keeps you connected seamlessly, and dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures comfort for all occupants.

Safety and convenience are seamlessly integrated throughout the vehicle. Dual front and side impact airbags, a comprehensive stability control system, and rear parking camera technology provide confidence in every situation. The speed-sensing steering, electronic brake assist, and traction control work together to enhance both daily driving and emergency handling. Auto high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers adjust automatically to road conditions, reducing driver fatigue and improving visibility.

Entertainment and comfort features make every drive enjoyable. SiriusXM satellite radio provides access to premium content, while the eight-speaker sound system delivers quality audio. Eight-way power adjustable seats with memory function allow you to find your perfect driving position instantly, and the leather steering wheel feels premium beneath your hands.

This CLA 250 represents an opportunity to own genuine Mercedes-Benz engineering and design without compromise. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this sedan combines luxury, efficiency, and reliability into one compelling package.

Much more fun than the turbo lag on subsequent model years. It's time for me to upgrade to four doors for my growing family, but my loss is your gain. Don't let this quick little car pass you by.

The leather seats and ice cold a/c will keep you cool next summer. Or open up the power sunroof and enjoy some of the cool weather this winter.

Lovingly maintained by local mechanic. Detailed maintenance records going back to 2011.

The transmission was completely replaced by Mini of Tempe at 65,000. A retread from a blown tire lying in the road managed to crimp the oil line running to the transmission, but nothing else was damaged.

Engine vibration damper, both window regulators, and front speakers recently replaced.

Extras:
Reinforced front strut towers
Front anti-sway bar
Rear anti-sway bar
2 lift, just enough to keep the bumpers above parking lot curb stones

Grom Bluetooth integrated with steering wheel music controls
Rear seats removed and replaced with a full-sized spare tire. Still have the rear seat, which will convey with vehicle and can be easily reinstalled.

2020 Hyundai Tucson SE FWD *Option Group 01* Nu 2L I-4 direct injection, DOHC, D-CVVT variable valve control engine with 161HP paired to a 6-speed automatic transmission, delivering a lively feel and sensible fuel economy for everyday driving.

*Option Group 01* provides added flexibility so you can personalize the Tucson to better match your needs, boosting the vehicle s practicality and ownership value without altering its fundamental strengths.

*Smart device mirroring* brings compatible phone apps onto the vehicle s display so you can access navigation and media through the infotainment system, making it easier to stay connected while keeping your focus on driving.

*Brake assist* senses emergency braking and immediately increases braking force to help shorten stopping distance, giving you an added layer of protection when sudden hazards appear.

*Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls* lets you set and adjust highway speed without taking your hands off the wheel, reducing fatigue on long trips and helping maintain steady fuel usage.

*Forward collision mitigation* watches the road ahead and prepares the vehicle to warn and, if needed, intervene to help prevent or reduce the severity of a frontal impact.

*Driver attention monitor* tracks driving patterns and alerts you if signs of drowsiness or inattention appear, nudging you to take a break before a risky situation develops.

*Lane departure prevention* helps keep the Tucson centered in its lane by detecting unintended drift and applying corrective measures, offering peace of mind on busy highways and long commutes.

*Keyfob keyless entry* lets you lock and unlock all doors remotely, so passengers can hop in quickly and you can secure the vehicle with a simple press as you walk away.

*Hill hold control* prevents rollback when starting on an incline by holding brake force momentarily, making uphill starts smoother and more confident, especially in stop-and-go situations.

*External memory control* lets the Tucson read and play media stored on USB drives or memory cards, so your playlists and files travel with you without extra setup.

The *rear camera* displays a live view behind the vehicle to simplify backing and parking, helping you spot obstacles and maneuver more confidently in tight spaces.

Well-balanced and user-friendly, the 2020 Hyundai Tucson SE FWD with *Option Group 01* pairs a practical interior and responsive powertrain with a thoughtful suite of technology and driver aids. Its compact footprint makes city errands easy while the included safety and convenience systems increase confidence on longer drives. If you value nimble handling, everyday comfort, and modern connectivity in a sensible package, this Tucson is worth a closer look stop by for a test drive to see how it fits your routine.

Porsche North Houston is delighted to showcase, this Brand New Certified 2026 Porsche Macan S Executive Demo. Dressed in an evocative Gentian Blue Metallic and with just 5,611 miles to its name, this vehicle is a testament to the potent combination of performance, versatility, and sophistication that Porsche embodies.

The Macan S commands attention with its Gentian Blue Metallic exterior, Side Blades in Exterior Color, Sport Tailpipes in Silver, and striking 21-inch Exclusive Design Sport Wheels in High Gloss Black. LED Headlights with Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+) and a Panoramic Roof System further enhance its unmistakable Porsche presence.

Step inside and the Leather Package in Black with Deviated Stitching in Gentian Blue creates a sophisticated and sporting environment. The Premium Package Plus adds Power Seats (14-way) with Memory Package, Heated Seats (Rear), Ventilated Seats (Front), and Lane Change Assist (LCA). Porsche Crests on the Front and Rear Headrests, an Electric Steering Column, and Surround View add further comfort and distinction.

Engine and Performance: At the heart of the Macan S is a 2.9-liter twin-turbocharged V6 engine producing 375 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque. Paired with Porsche's 7-speed PDK automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, it delivers responsive acceleration and confident performance. The Sport Chrono Package further sharpens the Macan S's dynamic character.

Key Features:

Premium Package Plus: Combines desirable comfort, convenience, and driver-assistance features for an elevated driving experience.

Sport Chrono Package: Enhances the Macan S with performance-focused driving functions and a more dynamic character.

21 Exclusive Design Sport Wheels in High Gloss Black: Provide a bold, athletic stance that complements the Gentian Blue Metallic exterior.

LED Headlights incl. Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+): Advanced lighting technology designed to optimize visibility and illumination.

Surround View: Provides additional visibility around the vehicle to assist with parking and maneuvering.

Panoramic Roof System: Opens the cabin to natural light while enhancing its spacious and luxurious atmosphere.

This 2026 Porsche Macan S is far more than just an SUV; it embodies Porsche's commitment to performance, luxury, and everyday versatility. Available at Porsche North Houston, it offers an engaging driving experience wrapped in unmistakable Porsche design.



Porsche North Houston is a member of the indiGO Auto Group and has received the highly coveted Porsche Premier Dealer status. Our dealership features a beautiful Porsche Corporate Identity showroom, fully staffed factory certified service center, parts department, finance department, detailing department, and Porsche accessories boutique. Allow us to also help arrange transportation of your new car directly to your home anywhere in the world. Trade-in proposals are always welcome. If you like this vehicle and have questions, simply call, email Porsche North Houston using the form on this page , or drop by our location at 13911 North Freeway (I-45N) on the northside of Houston. We invite you to Activate Your Ownership with us today!

description:
2023 Mazda CX-5 2.5 S Premium Plus Package immediately stands out for drivers who value a truly connected experience behind the wheel.

Enthusiasts who focus on how a vehicle feels will appreciate what this SUV delivers daily. It s perfect for those who notice the tactile feedback of the steering, enjoy a supportive yet supple ride, and expect the vehicle to respond predictably to every input. The Premium Plus Package elevates the interior with black leather and thoughtful details, making each drive both comfortable and immersive. Commuters who want more than just point-A-to-B transportation will find themselves looking forward to time in the driver s seat.

The SKYACTIV® 2.5L 4-Cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission provides a smooth, linear surge of power that feels both eager and refined. Throttle response is immediate, making merging and passing maneuvers feel effortless. The all-wheel drive system enhances grip, allowing the CX-5 to stay planted during quick lane changes or when the road turns twisty. Shifts are crisp and unobtrusive, and manual control is available when you want to take charge, adding to the sense of connection. Suspension tuning strikes a rare balance firm enough to inspire confidence, yet compliant enough for relaxed cruising.

Safety systems in the CX-5 are engineered to support, not intrude upon, the driving experience. Electronic Stability Control acts subtly, maintaining composure without dulling the SUV s lively feel. Brake assist and ABS work together to provide reassuring feedback through the pedal, giving you confidence on sudden stops. The exterior parking camera and rain-sensing wipers enhance situational awareness without distracting from the road ahead. Lane-keeping technology and high-beam assist are calibrated to intervene gently, preserving the driver s sense of command while providing an extra layer of security.

Premium Plus Package amenities elevate every journey. Heated and ventilated front seats, heated rear seats, and a heated steering wheel ensure comfort in any season. The power moonroof and power liftgate add convenience, while the heads-up display keeps your eyes focused on the drive. The 10-speaker audio system, AM/FM/HD radio, and integrated Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected and entertained. Features like dual-zone automatic climate control, memory seat function, and leather trim add refinement, while the MAZDA CONNECT infotainment system and voice command put control at your fingertips.

When compared to the Honda CR-V and Toyota RAV4, the CX-5 offers a more engaging steering feel and a chassis that prioritizes driver enjoyment without sacrificing comfort. Its interior materials and thoughtful feature set give it an upscale edge, while the all-wheel drive enhances confidence in all conditions. With EPA ratings of 24 city and 30 highway mpg, it competes efficiently with segment leaders, but stands apart for those who value rewarding dynamics every day. The standard powertrain warranty of 5 years/60,000 miles further reinforces its value proposition.

Is the CX-5 fun to drive every day? Absolutely the steering feedback, throttle response, and suspension tuning deliver a level of engagement rare among compact SUVs. How comfortable is the ride for longer trips? The seats offer excellent support, the cabin remains quiet, and the suspension filters out harshness without feeling disconnected.

For a test drive that showcases the CX-5 s rewarding daily experience, visit Bayway Chevrolet at 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX, 77581 or call . The team is ready to help you experience what sets this SUV apart and answer any questions about features, performance, or availability.
